import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/agent_guard_orphan_reconciler.py'


def load():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('agent_guard_orphan_reconciler', SCRIPT)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def test_reconcile_known_stale_agent_guard_owners_on_host():
    module = load()
    evidence = module.reconcile(apply=True)
    assert set(evidence['targets']) == set(module.TARGETS)
    for item in evidence['targets'].values():
        assert item['active_queue'] is False
        assert item['process_alive'] is False


def test_target_list_is_exact_and_no_wildcard_cleanup():
    module = load()
    assert module.TARGETS == (
        'worker-p1-result-publisher-idempotency-20260827',
        'worker-worker-canonical-python-runtime-20260826',
        'worker-worker-concurrent-producer-branches-v1-20260827',
    )
